patch.summary: Volunteer-run New Hampshire organization focused on individual liberty through legislative research, civic participation and community events.
patch.description:
NHLA describes itself as non-partisan and volunteer-run. Its work includes reviewing legislation, publishing the Gold Standard voting guide, Liberty Ratings, candidate support and civic involvement.

The organization offers membership, volunteering and events. Its official website links to a Facebook page, a separate Facebook group and an X account.

This is an independent directory profile, not an endorsement or an official NHLA service. The mailing address is not a confirmed walk-in location. The NHLA calendar is linked externally; its events are not automatically synchronized into this directory.
patch.accessInstructions: Browse the public website for research and events. Use the membership and volunteer pages to learn how to participate, or the organization’s general contact email for questions. Membership, event registration and social-group access are managed by NHLA or the destination service, under their own rules and privacy practices.
